name: Goko
description: 'Enlightenment'. A classic and elite cultivar from Uji, Kyoto, Goko is one of the most important traditional cultivars for producing the highest grades of Gyokuro and Matcha. It is celebrated for its ability to develop an intense, profound, and savory 'umami' flavor when shaded, creating the archetypal 'brothy' character of Uji Gyokuro.
